title: customs-dog-mcp
description: Pet travel docs + border readiness. Keyless: look up entry rules + sign up. Keyed: household docs.
summary: Pet travel docs + border readiness. Keyless: look up entry rules + sign up. Keyed: household docs.
offersHint: Pet travel docs + border readiness. Keyless: look up entry rules + sign up. Keyed: household docs. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://customs.dog/mcp

toolsPreview.name: customs_check_rules
toolsPreview.description: Per-destination pet border-entry requirements — NO account needed. What documents a dog needs to enter a country and re-enter the US. Use this to answer 'what does my pet need to travel to X?' for anyone. Omit `destination` to list every corridor.

toolsPreview.name: customs_start_signup
toolsPreview.description: Start a FREE customs.dog account for a NEW user by email and send them a magic sign-in link (no password). Use this to onboard someone who wants to store and track their pet's travel documents after you've shown them their border requirements.

toolsPreview.name: customs_prep
toolsPreview.description: Validate the session, confirm the pet roster, report health. Call first.

toolsPreview.name: customs_overview
toolsPreview.description: Counts of pets/documents by status, what's expiring soon, recent household activity, and MCP usage stats (per-tool call counts, public-tier reach, verdict distribution).

toolsPreview.name: customs_list_pets
toolsPreview.description: List the household's pets (source of pet_id).

toolsPreview.name: customs_check_trip_readiness
toolsPreview.description: Cleared / caution / blocked for pet + destination + return_date. NEVER assert clearance without this. (For rules without an account, use customs_check_rules.)

toolsPreview.name: customs_upcoming_trips
toolsPreview.description: Upcoming trips from the household's connected travel calendar (TripIt/Flighty/Google/Apple), each with per-pet readiness (cleared/caution/blocked). Use to proactively flag paperwork needed before travel.
